mapper.select: select r.*, m.mname, s.sname, s.sfiles from rating r join member m on r.mno = m.mno join store s on r.sno = s.sno where r.sno = #{sno} order by r.rno desc
select r.*, m.mname, s.sname, s.sfiles from rating r join member m on r.mno = m.mno join store s on r.sno = s.sno where r.mno = #{mno} order by r.rno desc

mapper.insert: insert into rating(rno, rtitle, rcontent, rrate, rfeature, rdate, mno, sno) values(RATING_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{rtitle}, #{rcontent}, #{rrate}, #{rfeature}, SYSDATE, #{mno}, #{sno})
